verdict: DEEP-BAR KILL TEST: NOT CLOSED -- and the deep regime is now a two-sided contradiction. SPARC deep (1152 rings): M1 = -0.276 x a0E[g_bar], z = -4.17 clustered (a0_eff = 0.73 a0, G208 register). MIGHTEE deep (72 rings): M1 = +1.164 x a0E[g_bar], z = +6.58 -- POSITIVE, ALREADY a >5-SE two-sided deviation (a0_eff ~ 2.0 a0, the G199 1.87x normalization rung): MIGHTEE does NOT close the SPARC deficit, it contradicts its sign. Budget: the measured -0.276 x a0E[g_bar] becomes a 5-SE kill at ~1656 deep rings at current per-ring noise, i.e. ~59 NEW deep-HI galaxies at ~3 rings each (177 new rings; total deep ensemble ~1329 rings / 194 galaxies) under the honest galaxy-clustered SE -- the binding unit is galaxies (clustered SE is 2.45x the ring-level SE), so deepening existing SPARC galaxies does not help. Discriminator: a 5-SE M1 kill excludes the normalization-only family {a0_eff = 1} but CANNOT attribute between H_A (a0_eff = 0.73 a0: slope 1/2, intercept -0.068 dex) and H_B (slope 0.55, intercept 0): the lines cross at 0.0433 a0 inside the band, BOTH produce the same -0.3 x a0E[g_bar] moment (H_B: -0.320), and the exact LR separates them at only 1.9 sigma at the kill N -- 5-sigma attribution needs ~11699 deep rings at SPARC-class scatter, OR the resolved-SED systematic-control recipe (0.045 dex scatter: ~542 rings) and/or a deeper band (g_bar -> 1e-3 a0: ~894 rings). Program card: MIGHTEE-class MeerKAT L-band HI + resolved 10-band SED, ~13x the published 19-galaxy yield, ~5-15 kh exposure class, ~2-3 yr; pre-registered kill/confirm/arbiter/discriminator criteria in N05_DEEP_BAR_PROGRAM.md.
